subtitle: Out Manila · Xiamen Airlines
overview: Fly Xiamen Airlines from Manila to Fuzhou, then visit Gexian Village and its night view, Lingshan Mountain and Wangxian Valley, and Wuyishan for Jiuqu Stream bamboo rafting and Wuyi Palace. The last morning explores Three Lanes and Seven Alleys in Fuzhou. Stays are in 5-star hotels, with one bottle of mineral water per person per day. No compulsory shopping.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 4–8 2026 to Feb 24–28 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Gexian Village: An ancient village in Jiangxi Province, visited in the evening for its lit-up night view.
placeDesc.Lingshan Mountain: A mountain scenic area near Shangrao known for its granite rock formations; an elevator is included.
placeDesc.Wangxian Valley: A scenic valley near Shangrao with cliffs, walkways and a lit-up night view.
placeDesc.Jiuqu Stream: The Nine-Bend Stream in the Wuyi Mountains, enjoyed on a traditional bamboo raft.
placeDesc.Wuyi Palace: A Song-style palace complex in Wuyishan, rebuilt as an ancient-style cultural attraction.
placeDesc.Imitation Song Dynasty Ancient Street: A street in Wuyishan built in Song Dynasty style, with shops, tea and local snacks.
placeDesc.Three Lanes and Seven Alleys: A historic district of Fuzhou with old lanes and well-preserved traditional houses.
